title: CorridorKey Workbench Parity & Multi-View Studio
highlights: Complete parity with official Workbench 2.0 algorithms, multi-mode viewport comparisons, and batch render queue.
features: Multi-Mode Comparison Viewport: Split horizontal, split vertical, math difference, opacity overlay, and single view modes
Buffer A / Buffer B comparison switching with instant keyboard swap (X)
Batch Render Queue: Collapsible drawer for batch processing multiple videos sequentially
Screen Color Auto-Detection: Automatically detects green or blue backing per shot with live despill unmixing
Core Solid Preservation: Keep original source details in solid core matte with erosion and edge blur tuning
Despeckle Noise Cleanup: Connected component filter to eliminate floating background noise islands
Alpha Guidance Keyframing: Set current frame as reference hint, configure hint quality, and carry memory across shots
Live VRAM Telemetry: GPU badge displays real-time memory usage and headroom
improvements: Optimized CUDA tensor cropping for native resolution passthrough
Standardized UI layout with charcoal studio palette and high-contrast badges
Interactive patch notes dialog with multi-update catchup support
fixes: Resolved tensor dimension mismatch during solid core source passthrough
Fixed border color unmixing during blue screen despill calculations

title: Quality Slider & Export Formats
highlights: Visual quality slider for exports and support for multiple video container formats.
features: Interactive Quality Slider: 1 to 10 scale adjusting CRF, bitrate, and encoder presets
Multi-Format Video Export: Support for MP4 (H.264), MOV (ProRes 4444 / ProRes HQ), and PNG/EXR image sequences
Linear Color Management: Asinh tone curve recovery with configurable brightness and contrast pivots
improvements: Enhanced FFmpeg hardware encoding flags for NVIDIA NVENC
fixes: Fixed audio stream preservation when remuxing export cutouts
Resolved alpha matte invert toggle behavior in viewer

title: CorridorKey Studio Re-architecture
highlights: Complete overhaul of GUI with modern PySide6 dark theme and PyTorch runtime engine.
features: Native PySide6 desktop interface with modern dark studio design
PyTorch runtime pipeline replacing legacy ONNX execution
Temporal Hann windowing streaming for long video processing with bounded VRAM
Hybrid GPU offloading for systems with limited video memory
improvements: Faster startup time and lazy model weight loading
Cross-platform support for Linux and Windows
